purpose: Validated operating model and safety boundary for a read-only Qwen audit of waivers, grants, suppressions, native configuration permissions, retired markers, and lens-specific claims.

verdict.implementation: The central authority coordinator is fail-closed across the tested wrong-door, malformed, duplicate, stale, over-broad, incomplete-owner, out-of-population and spoofed-metadata cases.
verdict.qwenRole: Qwen may reproduce denominators, trace evidence, and propose dispositions. It may not remove or add authority, change policy, treat consumption as justification, or make owner rulings.
materialCorrectionsBeforeDispatch: Count central grants from the runtime REVIEWED_GRANTS export, not literal object syntax: runtime is 480 rows across 67 policies while literal object counting sees only 423 rows across 64 policies.
Model @orb-waive-file separately from line-scoped @orb-waive: it binds an exact policy/position token anywhere in one file, and suppresses nothing when more than one candidate matches.
Treat native Biome, ESLint and dependency-cruiser configuration permissions as their own evidence plane with dedicated liveness gates.
Treat @orb-gate-ignore as retired inert residue; its hard inventory gate currently reports zero live markers.
Permit one reviewed-grant finding to aggregate many authored sites; the central 1:1 invariant is grant row to finding identity, not grant row to source occurrence.

pipeline.contract: The loaded policy roster owns id, family, authority and severity. A detector cannot supply or spoof policy metadata.

Each selected owner returns a declared population, completion state and raw findings. Empty successful populations, malformed results, outside-population findings, failed acquisition and incomplete analysis withhold the policy.

Only after complete owner evidence, hard findings remain effective, ordinary findings enter exact marker reconciliation, and reviewed-grant findings enter exact policyId/subject/operation reconciliation.

Stale, malformed, wrong-authority, duplicate-target and over-broad ordinary markers alarm. A reviewed grant consumed zero times after a complete owner run is stale; one exact match licenses one finding; multiple matches license none and alarm.
Effective error findings, authority alarms and tool errors block. Warning promotion changes blocking without rewriting severity. Withheld owners cannot produce a clean verdict.

hard.authoring: No inline marker and no central reviewed grant may suppress the finding.
hard.failureMode: A grant targeting a hard policy is a tool error; an @orb-waive naming it is wrong-authority and suppresses nothing.

ordinaryLineWaiver.purpose: An authored, local exception at one exact reported position.
ordinaryLineWaiver.binding: The parser reads real comments, not strings or prose mentions; the carrier and exact token must identify exactly one finding.
ordinaryLineWaiver.failureMode: Malformed, unknown-policy, wrong-authority, stale, dead-position, unbound-trivia, ambiguous-trivia, over-broad and duplicate-target outcomes alarm and suppress nothing.

ordinaryFileWaiver.purpose: An exact same-file escape for findings inside template literals or other spans with no useful adjacent syntax carrier.
ordinaryFileWaiver.binding: The exact policy and position token may match anywhere in that file.
ordinaryFileWaiver.failureMode: It is not blanket file suppression: zero candidates is stale or dead-position and multiple candidates is over-broad, licensing nothing.

reviewedGrant.shape: id, policyId, subject, operation, why, endsWhen
reviewedGrant.purpose: Central permission for a stable semantic finding whose exception should not be writable at the source site.
reviewedGrant.binding: Exactly one runtime grant row to exactly one complete-owner finding identity (policyId, subject, operation). A finding may aggregate many authored sites.
reviewedGrant.failureMode: Blank/control-bearing fields, unknown or wrong-authority policies, duplicate ids, duplicate identities, zero consumption and multi-consumption fail closed.

foreignSuppression.purpose: Instructions to foreign lint/type tools. They are product data for the suppressions policy, not Orb waiver syntax.
foreignSuppression.binding: Occurrences aggregate into one finding per foreign rule and source/tests scope. One central reviewed grant licenses that class; a scope ruling does not cross into the other scope.

nativeConfigurationPermission.purpose: Hand-authored native rule, selector and path policy that cannot safely be generated from current violations.
nativeConfigurationPermission.binding: Dedicated liveness gates load the native configuration and current tracked corpus. Dead selectors or file-exact paths are findings; absent-by-construction cases require exact central grants.
nativeConfigurationPermission.failureMode: The liveness reader refuses malformed, truncated, empty or otherwise unreadable native-tool evidence rather than declaring every grant dead or live.

retiredGateIgnore.purpose: None in the final runtime; the legacy parser survives only to inventory residue.
retiredGateIgnore.failureMode: gate-ignore-inventory is hard/error and reports every live authored marker.

lensMarker.binding: Owned by its lens reader and controls, outside central gate authority.
lensMarker.failureMode: Do not translate to a waiver or reviewed grant without an owner ruling.

ordinaryWaivers.freshness: No @orb-waive/@orb-waive-file marker line changed after the complete artifact.

reviewedGrants.antiPattern: Literal object counting returns 423/64 and is not the denominator.

declaredLimitsAndAuditHazards: Ordinary-waiver acquisition is carrier-bounded: authored .ts/.tsx/.d.ts plus declared CSS, Markdown, JSONC, JSON, and SQL resources. A raw repository grep is neither the admitted population nor proof that a marker can bind.

The foreign-suppression reader deliberately emits an unclassified debt site when it recognizes a directive but cannot parse its rule. Qwen must preserve null-rule sites instead of dropping or guessing them.

The suppression grammar has a tested word-boundary limit: a hyphenated longer spelling can parse as the shorter known token. Any such site is reader uncertainty or a tool-reader-defect candidate, not a confident rule classification.

Suppression-site de-duplication is one physical directive per source line. If a line authors multiple directive openers, Qwen must record the raw line and reader uncertainty rather than invent extra production-reader occurrences.

A current green authority run proves binding, completeness, cardinality, and liveness for the observed owner result. It does not prove that the exception remains architecturally justified or that its stated end condition is still accurate.

productionSuppressionReaderProbe.method: Run suppressionSites over every tracked and untracked JS/TS-family authored file, excluding the captured SillyTavern runtime.

perItem: authored site or complete sites array
prohibitions: Do not infer justification from successful consumption.
Do not invent a reason, end condition, consumer or owner ruling.
Do not edit, delete, add, move or rewrite any authority or source.
Do not use grep-only or source-literal counts as a semantic denominator.
Do not treat a tool error, timeout, truncated output, empty corpus or withheld owner as clean.
